covenants.quote: shall not, at any time during the period from 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 when its Net Leverage Ratio exceeds 2.50x, sell, transfer, contribute or otherwise dispose of any asset constituting Collateral to any Unrestricted Subsidiary where the aggregate value of all such transfers exceeds $500,000.00
covenants.formula_description: Springing limit on aggregate transfers of collateral assets to Unrestricted Subsidiaries, applicable only when Net Leverage Ratio exceeds 2.50x; aggregate transfer value must not exceed $500,000.00

carve_outs.quote: a transfer to a Restricted Subsidiary shall not be counted

covenants.quote: shall not permit its Net Leverage Ratio to exceed 3.00x as measured over the period from 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31
covenants.formula_description: Net Leverage Ratio = Net Debt / EBITDA; Net Debt = Financial Indebtedness drawn during the period less scheduled principal repayments in that period; EBITDA = Revenue less Operating Expenses

covenants.quote: shall not permit Revenue recognised in any single fiscal quarter falling within the period from 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 to exceed 0.30x, expressed as a multiple of Revenue for that period taken as a whole
covenants.formula_description: Maximum quarterly Revenue concentration expressed as a multiple (0.30x) of total-period Revenue
